description.zh: 应用ID。通过控制台创建和查询，仅支持传单个ID。
description.en: The application ID. Create and query this ID in the console. Only one ID is supported per request.

descriptions.zh:
### QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
### QPS limit

This API operation supports up to 10 requests per second per user. If you exceed this limit, rate limiting is triggered, which may affect your application. Call the API only as needed.
